verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers billing, checkout, MCP/agent tooling, and dunning/payout mechanics, but contains no documentation of data retention policies, deletion/erasure controls, or DSAR/GDPR data-subject workflows that an AI-native user could invoke. Community comments (paddle-comm-3, paddle-comm-4) only express general privacy unease about Paddle's data access, not evidence of any retention/deletion control mechanism. Missing for 10: any documented data retention policy, deletion/erasure API or dashboard control, and DSAR/export handling.
